audit.title: CCIP Program Interfaces Reference Documentation (Solana)
audit.contentType: developer documentation / API reference version-index (hub page)

dimensions.name: Answer-first extractability
dimensions.analysis: Opens straight into "Available Versions" with no self-contained statement of what the page/product is. A chunk lifted from the top answers no user question. Weak.

dimensions.name: Structural scannability & chunkability
dimensions.analysis: Strong for its size: 1 H1, clean H2/H3, 0 level skips, tidy bullets. No action needed beyond content depth.

dimensions.name: Concrete statistics & specifics
dimensions.analysis: 0 numerals in prose; only qualitative feature bullets ("configurable gas limits") and the version string `v1.6.0`. Add limits/params or link out.

dimensions.name: Citations & authoritative references
dimensions.analysis: 2 internal links, 0 external/primary. No link to the CCIP conceptual overview or SVM/Solana program-model spec.

dimensions.name: Quotable canonical definitions
dimensions.analysis: No one-sentence definition of "CCIP program interfaces" or "SVM." Nothing an engine can lift verbatim.

dimensions.name: Machine-readability & metadata
dimensions.analysis: Weakest measured area: 0 JSON-LD blocks, canonical MISSING, no datePublished/dateModified, no og/twitter tags. Head metadata could not be verified — CLI should pass raw `<head>`.

dimensions.name: Code completeness & agent-runnability
dimensions.analysis: No code fences. Acceptable for a pure index page, but a single "here's the minimal call" pointer would help agents route.

dimensions.name: Query/intent coverage
dimensions.analysis: Covers "available versions" and "documentation structure" only; misses "how do I send a CCIP message from Solana," "what is CCIP on Solana," and error/symptom queries.

dimensions.name: Clarity, fluency & terminology consistency
dimensions.analysis: Clear and consistent; "CCIP," "SVM," "SPL," "EVM" used correctly. Strong; no action needed.

audit.summary: This is a thin version-index/routing page (91 words, 4 sections) whose job is to point users to the CCIP v1.6.0 Solana reference. Its strength is clean, skimmable structure with a clear feature bullet list; its biggest opportunity is that it never states, in a liftable sentence, *what* CCIP on Solana (SVM) is or what these program interfaces do — so it offers a generative engine nothing quotable and no metadata anchor. Honest verdict: adequate as human navigation, but as a standalone GEO surface it is a low-value hub that will rarely be retrieved or cited; add one canonical definition and metadata, or accept that the child (v1.6.0) page carries the retrieval load.

recommendations.title: Add a canonical answer-first definition at the top
recommendations.where: Immediately under the H1, before "Available Versions"
recommendations.issue: Page opens with "## Available Versions" — no definition of the subject.
recommendations.change: Add 1–2 sentences: "The CCIP program interfaces for Solana (SVM) define the on-chain Rust/Anchor instructions, accounts, events, and error codes used to send cross-chain messages and token transfers from Solana to EVM and SVM chains. This reference covers the Router, Receiver, message structures, events, and error handling for CCIP v1.6.0."
recommendations.why: Gives engines a self-contained, liftable definition; defends against parametric priors that would otherwise describe generic CCIP/EVM behavior for a Solana query.

recommendations.title: Add symptom/intent-phrased entry points
recommendations.where: New short section or reframed bullets under "Documentation Structure"
recommendations.issue: "Documentation Structure" bullets are concept nouns ("Router Instructions", "Error Handling"), not questions.
recommendations.change: Phrase links as tasks: "How to send a message from Solana to EVM," "How to pay CCIP fees in SOL or SPL," "CCIP Solana error codes and troubleshooting."
recommendations.why: Devs/agents query by task and error string; question-phrased anchors win retrieval that noun-titled prose loses.

recommendations.title: Add TechArticle JSON-LD, canonical URL, and last-updated
recommendations.issue: Measured: 0 JSON-LD, canonical MISSING, no dateModified.
recommendations.change: Emit `TechArticle` JSON-LD with `headline`, `about: ["Chainlink CCIP","Solana"]`, `dateModified`, and a `<link rel="canonical">` to the svm reference URL; surface a visible "Last updated" line.
recommendations.why: Structured metadata and freshness signals raise parse-ability and E-E-A-T trust for agents. (Lower priority than retrieval fixes despite being mechanically detectable.)

recommendations.title: Add authoritative outbound links
recommendations.change: Link "SPL tokens" to the Solana SPL Token spec, "out-of-order execution" to the CCIP conceptual doc, and add a link to the CCIP architecture overview.
recommendations.why: Inline authoritative links raise credibility and citation rate.

recommendations.title: Add concrete specifics to feature bullets
recommendations.issue: "Configurable gas limits and out-of-order execution" — no values.
recommendations.change: State supported destination chain families, default/max gas limit values or where they're set, and the release date of v1.6.0.
recommendations.why: Quantitative specifics are among the highest-lift changes for citation.

antiPatterns: Thin/hub content: 91 words with no canonical definition — the page is navigation-only and offers no standalone answer.
Undated content: no visible or structured last-updated signal (measured: dateModified absent).
Concept-noun headings where task/question phrasing would retrieve better.
offPageNotes: `llms.txt` is already referenced at the top — good site-level signal; ensure it lists both this hub and the v1.6.0 child page.

As a hub page, its main GEO value is internal linking; ensure the CCIP overview and Solana landing pages link into it, and that it links deeply into v1.6.0 sub-pages so retrieval flows to the substantive content.
Head metadata could not be verified from the provided content — pass raw `<head>` to the CLI to confirm the JSON-LD/canonical gaps before acting.
